skills.name: skill-authoring
skills.description: Design or revise a narrowly scoped Agent Skill with explicit routing, progressive disclosure, and validation.
skills.subject: skill-system

skills.name: skill-discovery
skills.description: Select the smallest relevant skill for a task using descriptions, boundaries, and progressive disclosure.
skills.subject: skill-system

skills.name: skill-evaluation
skills.description: Evaluate whether an Agent Skill produces useful, bounded, and repeatable behavior on realistic tasks.
skills.subject: skill-system

skills.name: skill-intake
skills.description: Decide whether to adopt, adapt, rebuild, or create a skill from an external repository or a new personal need.
skills.subject: skill-system

skills.name: skill-maintenance
skills.description: Maintain, refactor, version, and retire skills without causing routing drift or duplicated guidance.
skills.subject: skill-system
